data.action: 独自跨坐木椅咬住腿带，一手抓椅背、一手腿间自抚，黑蕾丝褪至胸下
data.camera: low angle, cowboy shot, vertical framing
data.description: 【成年拉普兰德 · 红月寝室的自我支配】成年拉普兰德独自跨坐雕花木椅，破损黑外套与蕾丝上衣褪至胸下。她咬住腿带，一手抓紧椅背，另一手在腿间自抚；白发、狼耳与躁动尾巴被红月勾出锋利轮廓。
data.lighting: red moonlight from the side outlines hair and tail; low warm candlelight fills the carved chair and nearby curtains
data.location: 叙拉古古堡卧室内雕花木椅旁，深红床幔在后方
data.promptProse: Adult Lappland straddles the carved chair with the leather leg strap between her teeth, gripping its back while touching herself with her free hand. Red moonlight edges her hair and tail, with warm candlelight on the chair and the folds of the distant bed curtains.
data.title: 拉普兰德 · 恶兆红帐中的反客为主
data.animaCaption: The leg strap stays between her teeth as she grips the chair back.
